prompt: Make me a 16x16 pixel-art mushroom icon for my game: a red cap with white spots on a pale stem, transparent background, at most 6 colours. Save it as mushroom.png in this folder.
I need a 32x32 pixel-art treasure chest sprite for my game: a closed wooden chest with gold trim, on a transparent background, at most 8 colours. Save it as chest.png in this folder.
Make me a 16x16 pixel-art health potion icon: a round glass bottle with red liquid and a cork, transparent background, no more than 6 colours. Save it as potion.png in this folder.
Draw a 32x32 pixel-art knight character standing and facing the viewer, for a top-down RPG. Transparent background, at most 12 colours. Save it as knight.png in this folder.
I want a 16x16 pixel-art sword icon for an inventory slot, pointing up and to the right, transparent background, at most 6 colours. Save it as sword.png in this folder.
Make a 48x48 pixel-art oak tree for a top-down game map: a round leafy crown and a short trunk, transparent background, at most 10 colours. Save it as tree.png in this folder.

Make a spinning gold coin animation in pixel art: 16x16 pixels per frame, 6 frames, looping. Save the frames side by side as a sprite sheet coin_sheet.png (96x16) and also as a looping animated GIF coin.gif. Transparent background, at most 6 colours.

I need an idle animation for a green slime enemy in pixel art: 32x32 per frame, 8 frames, a gentle squash-and-stretch bounce that loops. Save it as a sprite sheet slime_sheet.png (256x32) and as a looping GIF slime.gif. Transparent background, at most 8 colours.

Make a side-view walk cycle for a small pixel-art adventurer: 32x32 per frame, 6 frames, looping. Save it as a sprite sheet walk_sheet.png (192x32) and as a looping GIF walk.gif. Transparent background, at most 12 colours.
Make a seamless 16x16 pixel-art grass ground tile for a top-down game. It has to tile without visible seams when repeated. Fully opaque, at most 5 colours. Save it as grass.png in this folder.

I need dirt-path tiles for a top-down game: a 3x3 set of 16x16 pixel-art tiles showing a dirt patch on grass (the four corners, the four edges and the centre), laid out in one 48x48 image, path_tiles.png. Fully opaque, at most 8 colours, and the pieces should join up seamlessly.

Make a looping campfire animation in pixel art for my game: flames over two crossed logs, 32x32 per frame, 8 frames, and it should loop smoothly. Save it as a sprite sheet fire_sheet.png (256x32) and as a looping GIF fire.gif. Transparent background, at most 8 colours.

I need a one-shot smoke puff effect in pixel art: 32x32 per frame, 8 frames, a puff that billows out and fades away. Save it as a sprite sheet smoke_sheet.png (256x32) and as an animated GIF smoke.gif. Transparent background, at most 6 colours.
